overview_description.description: Evergrove is a planned residential community that offers new homes within a master-planned neighborhood setting. The community features single-family homes built by Tri Pointe Homes and Toll Brothers on a range of homesites with one- and two-story floorplans. Evergrove provides shared amenities including an amenity center, fitness center, pools, splash pad, playgrounds, pocket parks, walking and biking trails, fishing areas and a community dog park. The neighborhood design incorporates preserved green space, mature trees and Jones Creek as a central natural feature. Evergrove also provides residents access to nearby schools, shopping, dining, parks and cultural attractions in the Richmond and greater Houston area.
